messages:
Sam (People Ops): Quick run-through: planning a 'Micro Recognition Week' (Jun 8-12). Goal: low-friction ways to recognize peers (desk cards, digital kudos, 15 gift cards). Need owners for printing, remote fulfillment, comms, and finance approval. Thoughts? :sparkles:

Taylor (Eng): Nice. I can help with prints in SF. How many cards?

Sam (People Ops): Thinking 400 printed cards across sites + 300 e-cards. Physical cards will have a QR to submit a short note if folks want a digital backup.

Jordan (Facilities): We can stock cards in SF lobby, NY pantry, and LON mezzanine. Who's shipping remote kits?

Priya (People Ops): I'll handle remote kits — small postcard + return envelope + prepaid stamp. Also drafting comms.

Alex (Finance): Rough budget: 15 gift cards x $40 = $600, printing $120, shipping $150 = $870 + buffer. Which cost center?

Sam (People Ops): Use recognition budget RC-2026. Can we get approval for up to $1,000?

Alex (Finance): Approved pending quick expense form and headcount estimate.

Taylor (Eng): I'll print mockups tonight and post images. Prefer matte stock?

Jordan (Facilities): Matte is fine. Ill coordinate distribution bins and signage. Also confirm pickup windows.

ops-bot: Reminder: use /recognize when converting cards to gift cards so Finance can reconcile. See /help recognize.

Priya (People Ops): Comms draft: 'Next month is Micro Recognition Week! Grab a card, write a quick thank-you, drop it in the bin or scan the QR to send an e-kudos. We'll pick 15 highlights for small prizes and Slack shoutouts.' Thoughts?

Taylor (Eng): Short and clear. Suggest adding the dates.

Sam (People Ops): Final checklist: prints (Taylor) , remote kits (Priya) , bins & signage (Jordan) , finance PO (Alex) pending. Please reply with  if you can take your task.

Jordan (Facilities): Bins & signage . I'll add to the facilities calendar.

Priya (People Ops): Remote kits . I'll prepare labels and a packing list.

Alex (Finance): Will approve PO once the form is in. Tag RC-2026 and capture receipts.

Sam (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Next touchpoint Wed 09:00 PT. If anyone wants to help judge the 15 picks reply here. :raised_hands:
